'''''Aftermath: Life Debt''''' or '''''Star Wars: Aftermath–Life Debt''''' is a [[canon]] novel written by [[Chuck Wendig]]. It is the second installment in ''[[Star Wars: The Aftermath Trilogy]]'', which was inaugurated with [[Aftermath (novel)|''Aftermath'']], and was released on [[July 12]], [[2016]]. The title received a paperback release on [[March 28]], [[2017]].
